rgb_to_xyz — IMGMETRICS colorspace op

• Data kinds: rgbimage → rgb

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.rgb_to_xyz(rgb) (to call the implementation directly, import imgmetrics; imgmetrics.rgb_to_xyz(rgb); from the registry, opsimgmetrics.get("rgb_to_xyz"))

Usage

sRGB ((..., 3)) → CIE XYZ. The transfer function is removed first, then the matrix is applied.

Procedure: srgb_to_linear normalises integer dtypes to [0, 1] while removing the transfer function (IEC 61966-2-1), then the sRGB (D65)→XYZ 3x3 matrix is applied to linear RGB. White (1, 1, 1) maps to (0.9505, 1.0, 1.0890) (a scale with Y normalised to 1).

• Input: any shape as long as the last axis is 3 (1 colour (3,), a colour table (N, 3), an image (H, W, 3)). Integer dtypes (uint8/uint16 etc.) are divided by the dtype maximum. float that does not lie in [0, 1] gives MetricContractError (ValueError subtype). Note that passing linear values with gamma already removed removes the gamma twice.

• Return value: float64 of the same shape as the input.

• Failure: the last axis is not 3 / float outside [0, 1] / non-finite.

The usual next step is to chain xyz_to_lab (rgb_to_lab does both).
